zh.title: 華航籌集180萬元公益款項捐贈團體 哩程捐贈突破百萬哩
zh.summary: 中華航空籌得180萬元捐贈公益團體；會員哩程捐贈累計突破百萬哩
body: 中華航空宣布攜手員工與華夏會員捐贈哩程回饋社會，共籌得新台幣180萬元款項捐予公益團體。華航於桃園新光影城舉辦愛心公益電影日，由華航資深副總經理李榮輝代表將義賣所得捐贈予家扶基金會、勵馨基金會、睦祥家園及桃園少年之家等單位，投入兒少照顧與弱勢家庭關懷服務。
此外，華航自去年11月推出「會員哩程公益捐贈」專區，提供華夏會員將哩程兌換為捐款。截至今年6月，該專區已吸引近300名會員參與，捐贈總哩程數突破100萬哩，受惠團體包括無國界醫生基金會、看見．齊柏林基金會及親愛音樂文化基金會等。

en.title: China Airlines Donates NT$1.8M to Charities via Staff Sales and Member Miles
en.summary: China Airlines raises NT$1.8 million for charitable groups through staff charity sales and member mileage donations.
body: China Airlines announced that it has raised NT$1.8 million for charitable causes through employee charity sales and member mileage donations. Senior Vice President Li Rong-hui represented the airline at a charity movie event held at Shin Kong Cinema in Taoyuan, presenting sales proceeds to organizations including the Taiwan Fund for Children and Families, The Garden of Hope Foundation, Mu Xiang Children's Home, and Taoyuan Youth Home to support child care and disadvantaged families.

In addition, China Airlines launched a member mileage charity donation initiative in November last year, allowing Dynasty Flyer members to convert mileage into charitable contributions. As of June this year, nearly 300 members have participated, contributing over 1 million miles to recipient organizations such as Doctors Without Borders, Beyond Beauty - Taiwan From Above Inc., and Chin-Ai Music Cultural Foundation.
